clue.text: Order in bar unacceptably reversed — that's jazz!

explanation.walkthrough: 'unacceptably' leans on the old U and non-U labels: U-speech was upper-class acceptable usage, so being unacceptable means losing the U. 'reversed' then turns the whole assembly round.
explanation.definitionFit: Bebop is a fast, complex style of modern jazz from the 1940s.
